headword: {有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}

definitions.explanation: Food produced using organic farming methods, without synthetic pesticides, chemical fertilizers, or genetically modified organisms.

examples.japanese: {有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I try to choose organic food.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧だ。
examples.english: This supermarket has a wide selection of organic food.

examples.japanese: {有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧や⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Organic food is more expensive than regular food, but it's said to be better for your health and the environment.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧ (organic) and ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧ (food products). In Japan, the ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧JAS⟦{認証|にんしょう}→認証：05909_ninshou⟧ (Organic JAS certification) is the official organic label regulated by the Ministry of Agriculture. Products must meet strict standards to carry the ⟦{有機|ゆうき}→有機：03643_yuuki⟧ label.
